title: fix(app-shell): a nav action item reads its action from its app's package (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
Fixes #32367

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Console 侧边栏与 `nav:menu` 里 `type: 'action'` 的导航项,读取动作定义时带上所在应用的包(`?package=`);`MetadataProvider.getItem` 新增可选的 `{ packageId }`。
- 为什么改:服务端现在对「两个已启用包同名的动作」的裸名读取回 `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`,两个应用里的导航动作都会弹「Action … is not defined.」而什么都不执行(ADR-0150 D5 / E2)。
- 风险与回滚:只影响带包的应用的导航动作读取;无包应用保持裸读。若某导航项引用的是别的包的动作,现在会被服务端拒绝(ADR-0150 行 U 已申报,lint 规则 `action-name-undefined` 在编写期已报)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`(`readPackagedItem`,不写入裸名缓存)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavActionDispatch.ts`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`(hook 调用移到 `activeApp` 之后)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavActionDispatch.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/MetadataProvider.itemReferenceKeys-7650.test.tsx`,预期全部通过,其中「each app's nav item opens the action its own package holds」两个包各打开自己的动作。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`useNavActionDispatch(packageId?)`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavActionDispatch.ts`): with a package, the action is read as `getItem('action', name, { packageId })`, the exact qualifier of ADR-0150 D5; without one, the call is byte-identical to before (`getItem('action', name)`).
- **Callers pass the package their app holds.** `UnifiedSidebar` passes `activeApp._packageId` in the app context and nothing on Home (Home's entries are the shell's own `url`/`group` items); the hook call moves below `activeApp`, before any return. `nav:menu` (`nav-menu-renderer.tsx`) passes the `appPackageId` it already computes for its object scope.
- **`MetadataProvider.getItem(type, name, options?)`**: with `packageId` it reads `meta.getItem(type, name, { packageId })` (or the draft-preview client's `get(type, name, { packageId })`), classifies the answer exactly as the bare read does (shared `itemReadFailure`), and does not cache it: `byName` holds the bare name's answer, and a package's item stored there would answer every bare reader with that one package's item.
- **`@object-ui/react`**: `MetadataContextValue.getItem` gains the optional third parameter, typed by the new exported `MetadataItemReadOptions`. A two-argument implementation still type-checks.
- Changeset: `.changeset/32367-nav-action-reads-its-package.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/react`, patch).

**Landing note.** The dispatch named the hook and its tests as the expected surface. Measured at `7d82b2dab`: the nav item does not carry its package (`NavigationItem` has no `_packageId`); the console holds it on the app (`activeApp._packageId`, read by both callers), and the provider's `getItem` took no package. So the fix lands in the hook, its two callers, the provider and the context type, which is the shortest path that keeps one read owner (the provider: draft preview and error classification included).

## Tests

- `useNavActionDispatch.test.tsx`, new top-level describe "an action name two packages hold": two packages each hold action `approve`; each app's nav item reads with its own package and dispatches that package's definition. CONTROL: an app with no package reads bare, two arguments exactly.
- `MetadataProvider.itemReferenceKeys-7650.test.tsx` (the by-name read harness), new top-level describe "getItem with the holding package": the double serves `?package=` addresses and refuses the bare read with `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. Each package's own item is read; a package's answer never answers a later bare read; CONTROL: a read without a package is the bare read and stays cached.
- Ablations (one-off, reported here, no test file kept), each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk anchor count and a `HEAD`-blob restore check:
  - hook names no package on the read: the two-package pin goes red (1 failed / 8 passed), and the CONTROL stays green;
  - provider ignores `options` and reads bare: both two-package provider pins go red (2 failed / 7 passed), and the CONTROL stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Declared narrowing, already recorded by ADR-0150 row U.** An app's nav item naming an action that only ANOTHER package holds used to open it through the bare read while that name had one holder. The exact qualifier refuses it, naming the holders. First-party count: none measured. The lint rule `action-name-undefined` already reports such an entry when the stack is authored, and D3's dependency-closure resolution (`?callerPackage=`) is served on `dataset` only. The PM's claim declares `Clause-②: no`, copied as given; the seat should confirm it, given this narrowing and the new optional parameter on the published `@object-ui/react` type.
- The card says the toast reads "Could not load action". Measured in the provider: `getItem` resolves `null` on a `409` (no throw), so the toast actually read `Action "approve" is not defined.` That is still wrong for a defined action, and a refused packaged read shows the same sentence, because `getItem` folds every failure into `null`. Not changed here.
- Executing a SERVER-run action (`createServerActionHandler`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/serverActionHandler.ts`) posts to `/api/v1/actions/global/NAME` with no namespace. For a name two packages hold, ADR-0150 D5 has that bare door answer `409`. That door was not measured here, and the read this PR fixes comes first. Noted, not filed (carrier: none).
